The '''father''' of [[Lobar Aybock]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Calian]] who lived on [[Shiva IV]]. He fought in constant conflicts between the [[Calian Confederacy]] and [[Twelve Tribes of T'Syriél]]. His son Lobar Aybock was a Calian who went on the become a successful [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]].<ref name="Fists of Ion" />
